pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 14.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: PLAY- RELATING TO REAL LIFE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What makes plays interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the characters in a play
2. discuss the various themes in a play

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the characters in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the characters in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. discuss the various themes in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss the various themes in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life.
4. Show that you can: identify the characters in a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Identify the characters in a play in pairs,
2. Discuss the themes that are evident in the play,
3. Discuss the appropriate costume for each character,
4. Perform a play for the school audience,
5. Communication and collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner works with others to rehearse and stage a play.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes plays interesting?
2. Why is it important for an actor to pronounce words correctly and speak audibly in a performance?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the characters in a play
2. discuss the various themes in a play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
